ahrc.definition: A function word to indicate presence or occurrence, a goal of an implied or indicated action, etc. Commonly used as a grammatical tool to identify the direct object of a verb. Alternate Translations: by; for; to; with Edenics: at - a moving at something
Or who, what or that. This word links the action of the sentence to the one doing the action.
